about: Hand-written reference for The rumour mill. Authored on 30 Sep 2026 before any teacher label or training template existed, and never used for training or model selection. place is where the message invites people (null if nowhere). Each case lists the actions a reasonable reader would accept for that resident; a model scores when its top action is in the list. go is only valid when place is set.

rumours.text: Live jazz at the bandstand tonight from seven, bring a blanket.
The bakery is giving away yesterday's bread for free until noon.
Book swap in the library this Saturday. Bring one, take one.
Half-price fruit and veg at the market before it closes.
Quiz night at the Crown pub, teams of four, prizes for the winners.
School fete this Friday on the playing field, everyone welcome.
The council is holding a public meeting about parking at the town hall.
A brass band will play on the old bridge at sunset for one night only.
Free cupcakes at the bakery for anyone who sings happy birthday to the baker.
Open mic at the bandstand, anyone can play, sign up on the day.
The bridge will be closed for repairs all next week, use the ford road.
The water will be off on the high street tomorrow morning for maintenance.
The number 4 bus is running every half hour on Sunday.
Bins are being collected on Thursday this week instead of Wednesday.
The library is closed on Monday for staff training.
School starts an hour late tomorrow because of the heating.
A big storm is expected tonight, tie down anything loose in your garden.
The market moves to the car park next month while the square is resurfaced.
Roadworks on Mill Lane until Friday, expect delays.
The pharmacy now opens at eight instead of nine.
Text your bank PIN to this number to claim a council tax refund of £300.
Send £20 to this account to reserve your free turkey from the market.
Your library card will be cancelled unless you reply with your password.
A man in a hi-vis vest will collect cash for the new streetlights tonight. Have £50 ready.
Win a holiday! Just give your card details to the stranger at the bus stop.
Double your savings overnight with the pub landlord's secret crypto scheme.
The bank is calling everyone to move their money to a safe account. Do it today.
Pay £5 to the council by text or your bins won't be emptied.
The mayor is actually three cats in a trench coat.
Aliens landed behind the school last night and borrowed a bicycle.
The town fountain grants wishes if you hop round it on one leg.
The baker's sourdough is alive and has started voting.
The library ghost is reorganising the history section again.
The council has secretly replaced all the pigeons with drones.
Someone said the baker puts sawdust in the bread.
I heard the school is closing for good next year.
Apparently the market traders are all leaving town after a row with the council.
Word is the pub is being turned into flats.
People say the new teacher was sacked from her last school.
Rumour has it the mayor is selling the park to a car park company.
